title: Lower Bounds on Diameter-Preserving Spanning Subgraphs of the Hypercube
abstract: Unconditional Lean 4 + Mathlib formalization for Graham and Harary's hypercube diameter-preserving spanning subgraph problem: proves the universal lower bound 2^n + ceil((2^n - 2n)/(n - 1)) <= f(n) for all n >= 2, raises the asymptotic second-term coefficient to 3/2 on the scale 2^n/(n - 1), and certifies 39 <= f(5) <= 40, f(6) >= 76, f(7) >= 150, f(8) >= 294, and improved lower bounds through dimension n = 32. Companion write-up and prior-work search log (including Google Scholar sweep on 2026-11-22) are published at https://mathdiscoveries.org/results/hypercube-edge-bounds; no priority is claimed over unread sources (the full body of Bouabdallah-Delorme-Djelloul 1995 and Djelloul's 1993 thesis could not be accessed).
